description:
Prerequisite for the fz-go4.18.4 spine deletion (like .18.7 moved the dumps and .18.8 moved the transport tests OFF the seal — the seal is also a TEST OBSERVATION POINT with consumers that must migrate before deletion).

TWO tests observed the seal's SemanticClosure as their deterministic FINAL snapshot:
- compiler2_quicksort_root_closes_with_a_finite_recursive_frontier (asserts a FINITE recursive frontier: qsort/append collapse to one key, partition inputs fold to [a2_e]/[a3_e], <=26 activations — the fz-y6w/fz-f98.14.10.2 over-specialization guard; its own comment: 'if this test ever flakes, the design has a hole and the flake has found it — do not loosen it').
- a generated-lambda provenance test.

The .18.4 deletion attempt re-pointed them at the RAW activation_analysis.defined telemetry STREAM, which republishes activation keys across fixpoint rounds -> the captured set is schedule-dependent -> the assertion flakes. The agent's #[ignore] is the REJECTED 'mark to avoid' shortcut and contradicts the test's 'do not loosen' contract.

CORRECT FIX: observe the FINAL SETTLED product activation inventory deterministically — the session's demanded/materialized executable set AFTER the drive quiesces (session.demanded_executables() / materialized_executables()), NOT the raw intermediate telemetry stream. Re-point both tests to that, preserving their assertions (finite frontier <=26, key collapse, lambda provenance). Do this on CURRENT HEAD (862262ee, seal still present) so it lands green+stable independent of the deletion; then .18.4 deletes the seal with these tests already off it (no #[ignore]).

CRITICAL SUB-QUESTION (correctness): is the FINAL settled inventory itself deterministic across runs, or does it vary? If it's deterministic (finite, stable) -> clean port, deletion proceeds. If the FINAL inventory varies -> the deletion exposed a REAL convergence non-determinism (activation-key republish churn is not just observation noise) -> that is a correctness bug (route to fz-f98.14 / the fz-go4.18.12 minimality audit) that BLOCKS the deletion until fixed. Report which. No #[ignore] to force green.
title: Re-point seal-snapshot tests (finite-frontier, lambda-provenance) at the deterministic product activation inventory
